name: E-Commerce: 3P Marketplace Seller Performance core scenarios
description: Evaluation scenarios for E-Commerce: 3P Marketplace Seller Performance.

parts.text: Which marketplace sellers have order defect rates exceeding our 1.0% SLA threshold?
Three sellers exceed the 1.0% ODR threshold: QuickFit Footwear (SEL-105) at 11.61%, EcoHome Essentials (SEL-104) at 1.90%, and Urban Luxe Apparel (SEL-102) at 1.53%.
What is our total marketplace commission revenue for July 2026 and who is the top contributing seller?
Total 3P commission earned in July 2026 was $79,245.00 across $669,000 in GMV, led by TechNova Gadgets (SEL-103) contributing $32,000.00 in commission revenue.
Are there any sellers experiencing severe catalog sync feed latency and error spikes?
QuickFit Footwear (SEL-105) has critical catalog feed latency of 180 minutes with 64 sync errors, followed by Urban Luxe Apparel (SEL-102) at 45 minutes latency.
What are the industry benchmark standards for 3P marketplace seller defect rates and take rates?
Major e-commerce marketplaces benchmark seller order defect rates strictly below 1.0%, with standard commission take rates averaging between 10% and 15% across consumer retail categories.
